sponsored.t: Expands the tax exemption for first-time home buyers
sponsored.sum: Expands the tax exemption levied on certain residential property for first-time home buyers by removing the requirement that such residential property be newly constructed.

sponsored.t: Relates to a death benefit option for the wife of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a death benefit option for the beneficiary of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo, a justice of the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; relates to the management and control as well as the usage of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by such association.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a portion of the 2024-2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2025 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Gurdwara Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Gurdwara Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib, Inc. for all of the 2023 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption during any period of strike by an employee organization, work stoppage or declared state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Provides that no individual or entity shall be charged a central business district toll during any period of strike by an employee organization, work stoppage or declared state of emergency that causes a stoppage for more than twenty-four hours or significant delays of any metropolitan transportation authority, metro north commuter railroad, New York city transit authority, or Long Island railroad services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the public campaign finance board and certain matching funds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the public campaign finance board to accept an application/certification form jointly signed by candidates for governor and lieutenant governor for eligibility to participate in public matching funds.

sponsored.t: Requires the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey take steps to update noise exposure maps
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Requires the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey take steps to update noise exposure maps and take steps to reduce noise pollution around certain covered airports; defines covered airports.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "veterinary care of retired law enforcement and fire service canines act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "veterinary care of retired law enforcement and fire service canines act" which establishes a program to cover the cost of veterinary services for retired law enforcement and fire service canines.

sponsored.t: Establishes the persistent domestic violence offender registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes the persistent domestic violence offender registry to provide information on the persistent domestic violence offender, including but not limited to, the name, date of birth, conviction date, county or counties of convictions, and a current photograph of any person who was convicted of an offense against a victim of domestic violence and has at least one prior conviction for a family offense committed against a member of the same family as defined in subdivision one of section 530.11 of the criminal procedure law; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to study and plan for integrating blockchain technology into health care platforms
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to study and plan for integrating blockchain technology into the New York State of Health Marketplace and the Statewide Health Information Network for New York (SHIN-NY) to improve interoperability and efficiency across these platforms; requires reporting; allows for public comment.

sponsored.t: Provides for an energy price refund credit
sponsored.sum: Provides for an energy price refund credit for certain taxpayers based upon a taxpayers income.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs; requires such standards to utilize non-aversive, evidence-based, and positive reinforcement techniques.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain borrowing arrangements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain borrowing arrangements; relates to the authorization for the contracting of debt; relates to the manner by which payments are appropriated and paid.

sponsored.t: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law
sponsored.sum: Requires that any bill which provides revenue to the state in a non-recurring manner shall pass by a two-thirds majority in order to become law.

sponsored.t: Limits the power of the legislature to amend a redistricting plan submitted by the independent redistricting commission
sponsored.sum: Limits the power of the legislature to amend a redistricting plan submitted by the independent redistricting commission where it affects more than two percent of the population of any district contained in such plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to salary increases for members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Requires proposed salary increases for members of the legislature to be submitted to the people at the next general election.

sponsored.t: Suspends employer contributions to the interest assessment surcharge fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Suspends employer contributions to the interest assessment surcharge fund until December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the issuance of "I Support Music Education" distinctive plates and establishes the "I support music education" fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the issuance of "I Support Music Education" distinctive plates and establishes the "I support music education" fund.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of labor to collect and report certain information regarding requests for federal Title XII advances for the state unemployment trust fund
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor to collect and report certain information regarding requests from the governor or the governor's authorized agent for federal Title XII advances for the state unemployment trust fund.

sponsored.t: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers as hate crimes and makes graffiti a hate crime
sponsored.sum: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers as hate crimes; designates making graffiti as a specified offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain requirements regarding the purchase and sale of a catalytic converter
sponsored.sum: Requires sellers of catalytic converters to provide certain information to potential buyers; requires buyers to maintain records of such purchases; makes any violations a class A misdemeanor; imposes a fine of up to $5,000.

sponsored.t: Requires a three year moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature and restores the mandate relief council
sponsored.sum: Requires a three-year moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature; invalidates legislation that does not contain a detailed fiscal note identifying a funding source for certain costs to a political subdivision; restores the mandate relief council.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting on the metropolitan transportation authority's state of good repair
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting on the metropolitan transportation authority's state of good repair; requires the reporting to be published on the authority's website, outlining the repairs and investments needed to restore the authority's existing transit systems to a state of good repair.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to provide state funds to community colleges for additional operating costs associated with an increase in the state minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to provide state funds to community colleges for additional operating costs associated with an increase in the state minimum wage; requires the board of trustees of community colleges to report to the state comptroller on an annual basis the amount of such additional operating costs.

sponsored.t: Requires certain elected officials to sign and publicly post a certificate proving they completed their sexual harassment training program
sponsored.sum: Requires certain elected officials to sign and publicly post a signed certificate proving they completed their sexual harassment training program.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention
sponsored.sum: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; adds class B felonies under article two hundred twenty of the penal law as qualifying offenses.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Learning for Work" act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "learning for work act"; establishes the youth apprenticeship program and the enhanced regents professional diploma; appropriates moneys therefor.

sponsored.t: Directs the board to submit a recommendation regarding the central business district toll amounts to the legislature and recommending a privacy risk plan
sponsored.sum: Directs the board to submit a recommendation regarding the central business district toll amounts to the legislature and also to recommend a privacy risk plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring businesses to meet certain green requirements to be eligible for the START-UP NY program
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring businesses to meet certain green requirements to be eligible for the START-UP NY program; businesses operating in newly constructed buildings shall be powered by at least thirty-five percent alternative energy; businesses operating in already existing buildings shall utilize at least forty-five percent less electricity than neighboring businesses of similar size and business type.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education to create a competition among SUNY and CUNY schools with prizes going to the schools that produce the most cost-efficient method of reducing CO2 emissions
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the commissioner of education to create a competition among SUNY and CUNY schools with prizes going to the schools that produce the most cost-efficient method of reducing CO2 emissions; the top three schools shall receive a cash prize which shall be used to improve environmental programs at the university.

sponsored.t: Requires propositions authorizing creation of a state debt to contain an estimate of the debt service payable and publish an explanation thereof
sponsored.sum: Requires that any ballot proposition creating a state debt shall contain an estimate of the amortization period and the total expected debt service payable thereon until the bonds issued pursuant to such proposition are retired; relates to deposits to the tax stabilization reserve fund; provides that at least 10% of any surplus shall be used to pay down state debt.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the legislature from recessing after the start of the state fiscal year until it has passed a budget
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the legislature from recessing after the start of the state fiscal year until it has passed a budget; allows recess during such period for public holidays.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain former full-time police officers to be eligible to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes former full-time police officers with the New York city police department to be eligible to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and contingent on their score, to be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer for the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sufficiency of itemization in the state budget
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sufficiency of itemization in the state budget; requires budget bills to clearly reference the section in the accompanying bill or bills where the corresponding appropriation or reappropriation can be located and requires that the legislature not act upon bills that neglect to do so.

sponsored.t: Relates to the tax stabilization reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Increases the maximum percentage allowed to be deposited from surplus revenues into the state tax stabilization reserve fund to 4 percent.

sponsored.t: Requires town attorneys in the county of Nassau to collect fines
sponsored.sum: Requires town attorneys to institute proceedings to collect fines, restitution or reparation in towns contained within Nassau county.

sponsored.t: Provides a preference for New York state contractors for purposes of public works contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides a preference for New York state contractors for purposes of public works contracts; authorizes the commissioner of economic development and the commissioner of labor to promulgate necessary rules and regulations; requires a report to the legislature; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of portions of certain settlement funds to the state's general debt service fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to the payment of 5% of settlement funds totaling $1,000,000 or more to the principal balance of the state's general debt service fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting witnesses in criminal prosecutions from intimidation and threats
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting witnesses in criminal prosecutions from intimidation and threats by permitting the court to withhold disclosure of names and other information if the court finds on the record that such witness is subject to potential intimidation, violence or threats.

sponsored.t: Establishes a child care program capital improvement tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a child care program capital improvement tax credit program for child care programs to provide financial assistance to New York's child care providers to facilitate the enhancement, expansion, and improvement of access to quality child care.

sponsored.t: Increases the aggregate funds available for the child care tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the aggregate funds available for the child care tax credit for businesses that provide child care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of special franchise property
sponsored.sum: Exempts water system property owned by a private water-works corporation located in counties with a population of one million or more that are special assessing units from being included as special franchise property.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "dismantling student antisemitism act", or "DSA act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "dismantling student antisemitism act", or "DSA act"; requires mandatory sensitivity training that includes the topic of antisemitism; includes reporting requirements regarding antisemitism complaints and disciplinary processes.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat; establishes a $100 credit for a maximum of three dogs or cats per taxable year.

sponsored.t: Relates to setting bail for defendants that pose a current physical threat to public safety
sponsored.sum: Requires the court to make an individualized determination whether a defendant poses a current physical threat to any person or to public safety when making a bail determination.

sponsored.t: Establishes a supplemental household and dependent care credit payment
sponsored.sum: Establishes a supplemental household and dependent care credit payment for taxpayers who are eligible for certain household and dependent care services necessary for gainful employment.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York first--shop local program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York first--shop local program to provide immediate assistance to small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 outbreak; defines terms; provides that such program shall identify eligible applicants and projects that promote local products and services by providing marketing and business assistance services; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a state agency adopting emergency regulations
sponsored.sum: Requires a state agency to get approval from the senate and the assembly prior to adopting or readopting a rule on an emergency basis unless such rule is necessary on an emergency basis for the preservation of the public health, safety and general welfare of the public.

sponsored.t: Relates to the approval of reimbursement methodologies for tuition and maintenance
sponsored.sum: Establishes that tuition rates shall grow by a percentage equal to the general support for public schools appropriation provided to schools.

sponsored.t: Repeals the portion of the criminal procedure law dealing with discovery and the ability for a defendant to request access to a crime scene or other relevant premises
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions dealing with discovery and the ability for a defendant to request access to a crime scene or other relevant premises.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of tampering with electronic monitoring equipment
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of tampering with electronic monitoring equipment; makes such crime a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Creates the utility consumer advocate of the Long Island office of the department of public service
sponsored.sum: Creates the utility consumer advocate of the Long Island office of the department of public service to advocate and to represent the interests of residential Long Island utility customers.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements for the department of transportation
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to submit annual reporting to the minority leader of the senate, the minority leader of the assembly, the ranking minority member of the senate transportation committee, the ranking minority member of the assembly transportation committee, the ranking minority member of the senate finance committee, and the ranking minority member of the assembly ways and means committee.

sponsored.t: Establishes the senior housing accessibility study group; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the senior housing accessibility study group to examine and make recommendations for amending the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code to improve and enhance accessibility requirements for all newly constructed or substantially reconstructed senior housing developments.

sponsored.t: Increases the applicable percentage of the child tax credit allowed in the empire state child tax credit to forty-five percent
sponsored.sum: Increases the applicable percentage of the child tax credit allowed in the empire state child tax credit from thirty-three percent to forty-five percent; prescribes how such payment or refund should be made based on amount.

sponsored.t: Increases the earned income tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the earned income tax credit for taxable years beginning in 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements for the START-UP NY program
sponsored.sum: Relates to disclosure authorization and reporting requirements for the START-UP NY program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of appropriations for humanitarian aid including short term shelter services to migrant individuals and families
sponsored.sum: Provides that the comptroller shall examine and audit all state or federal funds appropriated or received for the humanitarian aid including short term shelter services to migrant individuals and families, including costs associated with humanitarian emergency response and relief centers for individuals entering short term shelter on or after April 1, 2024 in New York city or any other municipality in New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a cancer treatment credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a cancer treatment credit for the cost of medical expenses.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to provide certain information to patients who have suffered a traumatic brain injury
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to provide information on care and resources for brain injuries to patients who have suffered a traumatic brain injury and to also provide such information to a patient's family and/or caregivers.

sponsored.t: Requires the notification to veterans of the availability of veterans' services free of charge by federal, state, and local veteran agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires the notification to veterans of the availability of veterans' services free of charge by federal, state, and local veteran agencies; requires certain disclosures to be provided when notifying veterans about available services; provides for civil penalties for any violations.

sponsored.t: Provides for an annual growth amount for tuition and regional rate reimbursement for approved school-age and preschool special education programs
sponsored.sum: Provides for an annual growth amount for tuition and regional rate reimbursement for approved school-age and preschool special education programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring state agencies, public authorities and public benefit corporations to provide annual reports
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies, public authorities and public benefit corporations to provide annual reports including information on outstanding total debt for each entity, total annual debt service for each entity, annual debt issuance for each entity, and annual debt to be retired for each entity.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Long Island transportation account
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Long Island transportation account within the New York city transportation assistance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to reserve funds for pupil transportation costs
sponsored.sum: Provides that any school district may establish a reserve fund for the payment of unanticipated costs related to pupil transportation in excess of public funds apportioned to districts for such purposes.

sponsored.t: Adds intergovernmental loans to the definition of state-supported debt
sponsored.sum: Includes intergovernmental loans as a form of state-supported debt.

sponsored.t: Establishes oversight of debts issued during a state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Establishes oversight of debts issued during a state of emergency; establishes the procedure of how the legislature may oversee such debts issued during a state of emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing legislative oversight on the issuance of short-term liquidity financing
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing legislative oversight on the issuance of short-term liquidity financing.

sponsored.t: Exempts purchases made by civic associations from sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts any purchase made by a civic association used or intended to be used in such civic association's course of business from sales and compensating use tax.

sponsored.t: Creates an in vitro fertilization treatment tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates an in vitro fertilization treatment tax credit for up to three cycles of in vitro fertilization treatment for expenses related to treatment for infertility.

sponsored.t: Requires enacted budget financial plan estimates to be provided to the legislature prior to a vote on certain budget bills
sponsored.sum: Requires enacted budget financial plan estimates to be provided to the legislature prior to a vote on certain budget bills.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative oversight for debt issuances that reach maturity if such maturity exceeds thirty years
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative oversight for debt issuances that reach maturity if such maturity exceeds thirty years; provides for the procedure for such debt issuance by the legislature.

sponsored.t: Places kratom on the schedules of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Establishes kratom, otherwise known as mitragyna speciosa korth, as a schedule I controlled substance.

sponsored.t: Creates the non-partisan office of policy research and fiscal analysis
sponsored.sum: Creates the non-partisan office of policy research and analysis.

sponsored.t: Requires an independent forensic audit of the metropolitan commuter transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan commuter transportation authority to contract with a certified independent public accounting firm for the provision of an independent, comprehensive, forensic audit of the authority to examine redundancies, inefficiencies, and the authority's governance system.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "blocking illegitimate reservations and defending individual entertainment (BIRDIE) act"
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "blocking illegitimate reservations and defending individual entertainment (BIRDIE) act" to prohibit third-party reservation services from listing, advertising, promoting or selling reservations for state-owned golf courses; provides monies received from penalties shall be deposited in the golf fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cannabis storefronts from being located within a certain distance from any town, city or village which has opted out of permitting the sale of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cannabis storefronts from being located within a quarter mile from any town, city or village which has opted out of permitting the sale of cannabis.

sponsored.t: Expands who the director of budget shall report to in regard to the healthcare stability fund
sponsored.sum: Expands who the director of budget shall report to in regard to the healthcare stability fund; expands the criteria of reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Imposes a fee for certain convictions to benefit animal shelters and establishes the animal offenses assistance fund
sponsored.sum: Imposes a fee for certain convictions to benefit animal shelters; establishes the animal offenses assistance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring state agencies to post public reports in certain formats
sponsored.sum: Requires each state agency that publishes reports containing data on its website to post such reports in a machine-readable format; requires the state comptroller to conduct compliance audits and issue a written report to the legislature, the governor, and the audited agencies.

sponsored.t: Relates to businesses with fewer than twenty employees
sponsored.sum: Provides that any taxpayer who employees twenty or fewer employees, the first fifty thousand dollars is exempted from taxation.

sponsored.t: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail
sponsored.sum: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to recusal by a court of appeals judge
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a court of appeals judge recuses themselves from sitting in or taking part in the decision, action, claim, matter, motion or proceeding, a replacement shall be chosen on a rotating basis, based on seniority, of the next available appellate division judge.

sponsored.t: Provides an extension for payment of real property taxes owed by a federal employee furloughed or designated non-pay due to a lapse in federal appropriations, or their spouse or domestic partner
sponsored.sum: Provides a temporary extension for payment of real property taxes owed by a person who has been a furloughed or designated non-pay federal employee due to a period of lapse in discretionary appropriations by the federal government, or by the spouse or domestic partner of such person; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of transportation to study the regional fairness of state funding for local roadway paving purposes
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to study the regional fairness of state funding for local roadway paving purposes, including but not limited to the Consolidated Local Street and Highway Improvement Program (CHIPS), State Touring Routes program, PAVE-NY, Pave Our Potholes (POP), and other existing local roadway aid programs, and to make recommendations concerning the reinstatement of the suburban highway improvement program (SHIPS) funding program.

sponsored.t: Relates to health insurance coverage for surviving dependents following the death of a police officer by suicide
sponsored.sum: Provides that where an active or retired police officer dies by suicide and is enrolled in a health insurance plan, the surviving dependents of such police officer shall be entitled to such health insurance coverage for ninety days following such police officer's death.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from The Cathedral of the Incarnation in the Diocese of Long Island
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from The Cathedral of the Incarnation in the Diocese of Long Island.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dawn Ward
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Dawn Ward.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the authority for Nassau county to impose certain taxes and fees
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the county of Nassau to impose hotel and motel taxes; extends the expiration of certain provisions relating to a surcharge on tickets to places of entertainment in such county, a charge for copying and searching for police accident reports, and receipt of service charges by the Nassau county traffic and parking violations agency; extends the authority of Nassau County to impose additional sales and compensating use taxes and local government assistance programs in Nassau County.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad of West Hempstead
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad of West Hempstead for a portion of the 2022-2023 school taxes, a portion of the 2023 general taxes; all of the 2023-2024 school taxes and all of the 2024 general taxes; and all of the restored 2024-2025 school taxes and all of the restored 2025 general taxes.
